prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1268
Claimant:
Sean Faulkner
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
2024-06-16
First notice of loss received from the insured reporting a low-speed head-on collision at a residential intersection. The
claimant is the other driver and has retained counsel, so all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
2024-07-19
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of the reported loss. No issues
with policy status were found.
2024-08-26
Obtained photographs of both vehicles from the scene and statements from two independent witnesses. Both
witnesses describe the vehicles meeting nose to nose at low speed, consistent with the insured's account.
2024-09-18
Spoke with the other driver, who gave the same description of how the collision happened. Their account matches the
witness statements and the scene photos.
2024-11-04
Reviewed the damage photos with our appraiser. The damage pattern is mostly in line with the described impact, and
no prior damage to the vehicle is known from our records or the repair history.
2024-11-15
Received the medical records and claim package from the attorney's office. The claimant reports a wrist fracture,
which fits the kind of force expected from a collision of this type.
2024-11-25
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, so the file has been flagged for a standard review of
the treatment plan and billing.
2024-11-30
Requested prior medical history from the claimant through counsel. No earlier injruy to the same wrist or arm has
been identified in the records received so far.
2025-01-01
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who confirmed the client is still following the treatment plan. The claimant has
given the same account of the accident in every conversation we have had.
2025-01-13
Noted that the seating position of the claimant at the time of impact is not yet fully clear from the statements and
photos. Asked counsel to confirm seat position for the file.
2025-01-24
Nothing so far suggests the damage predates the policy start date. The file remains open pneding the treatment
review and the seat position confirmation.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
